name: Infobip Message
description:
Infobip Message lets your AI agent send messages across SMS, RCS, MMS, and Viber through a single tool call, with possibility to get delivery reports back so your agent knows whether the message landed.
Built for straightforward notification and alerting use cases, like order confirmations, delivery updates, appointment reminders, and one-off customer notices, where you want simple, reliable delivery without managing channel-specific logic.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Infobip Message to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Infobip Message to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.infobip.com/message. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Infobip Message MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Infobip Message provides these MCP tools: check_status and send.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Infobip Message?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Infobip Message in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Infobip Message MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Infobip Message requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Infobip Message is developed by Infobip. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
